title: What did you set aside?
subtitle: Follow an unlived part of you back to what still wants expression.

steps.body:
Some of who you are got set aside — too much, too loud, not allowed, not safe to be.

Not gone, though. Just waiting. This is a gentle look at what's been kept in the dark.

steps.title: Is there a quality or way of being you set aside long ago?
steps.body: A talent, a boldness, a softness, a desire. Name it, however roughly.
steps.placeholder: Something I used to be, or never let myself be…

steps.title: What, or who, taught you it wasn't allowed?
steps.body: Not to assign blame — just to see that this was learned, which means it isn't simply fact.
steps.placeholder: A parent, the times, myself, a moment…

steps.title: How does it feel to name this?
steps.body: Naming something unlived can stir grief. Just notice where you are.
Take a breath. There's often grief here — for the time, for what wasn't allowed. That's okay to feel.

steps.title: What wants expression through you now?
steps.body: Don't edit it. Just let it be said, even if it feels impossible.

steps.title: If the smallest doorway opened — where might a little of it peek out?
steps.body: No obligation. Not a plan, not a transformation. Just notice where it might fit.

exit.body: You met what wants to be known. Its becoming is entirely yours — the app won't track it, measure it, or tell you what to do with it.
